title: Talk: Video Games and the Future of Education
summary: Jonathan Blow gives a roughly 90-minute talk, followed by Q&A, on how video games could actually improve education, in contrast to what is currently being tried.
why: HN commenters find his insights good, especially the idea that games work for learning by doing and for teaching problem-solving, in contrast to gamification.

quote.text: they're not explicitly educational games about specific topics, but they teach problem-solving skills in an engaging way
